Privacy Policy & Project Terms

Privacy, project purpose and music credits for Squaremageddon.

Offline gameplay On-device records No advertising or tracking

Last updated: November 5, 2026

This policy explains how Calasanz Studios handles information in the Android game Squaremageddon (package name: com.squaremageddon.game).

Built together as a family. Squaremageddon is a non-profit educational project by Calasanz Studios, created to learn, experiment and share the experience of making a game together as a family.

In brief: Squaremageddon is an offline game. Your nickname, scores and preferences stay on your device. The game does not send them to Calasanz Studios or other players.

01Information stored on your device

The game saves the following information in its local app storage:

  • Your chosen player nickname and the last nickname used, so you can enter and view local high scores. You can use an alias; a real name is not required.
  • Your local top-five leaderboard, including scores, survival times and enemies defeated.
  • Your language selection, music and sound-effect volumes, and mute settings.

These records support gameplay and remember your preferences. The leaderboard is local to your device and is not published online.

02Collection, transmission and sharing

Squaremageddon does not transmit player information to Calasanz Studios. The game does not require an account or login, and does not include advertising, analytics or third-party tracking SDKs.

The game does not request access to your contacts, location, camera or microphone. It does not collect advertising identifiers or persistent device identifiers. Calasanz Studios does not sell or share information from your device.

03Storage, retention and deletion

Saved records remain in the game's app storage until they are replaced during normal use or you delete the app's data. Squaremageddon does not provide cloud synchronization or a developer-operated backup service.

You can delete saved nicknames, high scores and preferences through Android's settings: open Apps > Squaremageddon > Storage and choose Clear storage or Clear data. Labels may vary by device. This resets the local leaderboard and preferences.

Calasanz Studios has no remote access to these local records and cannot retrieve or delete them remotely.

04Google Play, Android and this website

Google Play Families Policy. Calasanz Studios is committed to meeting the requirements of the Google Play Families Policy for Squaremageddon.

Google Play and Android operate independently of Calasanz Studios and handle information according to their own policies. This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. Website hosting is provided independently of the offline game; see GitHub's Privacy Statement for information about the hosting service. You can read Google's Privacy Policy for information about Google's services.

05Privacy inquiries

For questions about this policy or Squaremageddon's data handling, contact Calasanz Studios:

andres.julian.lusi@gmail.com

Contacting us is optional. If you send an email, we receive your email address and the information you choose to include. We use that information to respond to your inquiry and retain it only as long as needed to handle the request or meet applicable legal obligations. Please avoid sending sensitive information.

06Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the game's features or data practices change. Updates will be published on this page with a revised date.
